In this Mauritius vlog, we explore an amazing road trip from Port Louis to the central and southern parts of Mauritius.
The journey begins at the historic Fort Adelaide, also known as La Citadelle, offering beautiful panoramic views of Port Louis and the Indian Ocean.
From there, we drive across Mauritius and explore Chamarel Waterfall, the famous Seven Coloured Earth, Aldabra giant tortoises, Le Morne Beach, Gris Gris Beach and Ganga Talao, also known as Grand Bassin — one of the most sacred Hindu pilgrimage sites in Mauritius.
